headline.text: L1 S3 enrober wire belt ran with *broken link* until caramel exhausted — replaced during planned stop, no FM found.

summary: One active hold resolved (L3 ML4 auger pin found after 26-minute search). L1 S3 enrober wire belt ran with broken link under supervision until batch complete. L3 ML1 filter basket startup miss highlights checklist gap.

holds.title: ML4 auger pin lost during washing
holds.summary: Auger pin lost during TG3 cleaning at 06:08; operators held on shift to search, pin recovered at 06:34 — 26-minute delay to startup.
holds.status: Resolved — pin found at 06:34, startup resumed.

food_safety.title: S3 enrober wire belt broken link
food_safety.summary: Broken link discovered on enrober belt at 00:42; maintenance and lead approved running caramel to completion under continuous inspection, line stopped at 03:10 for 17-link replacement, restarted at 06:03.
food_safety.status: Resolved — belt replaced, line restarted after reheat at 06:03.

food_safety.title: S4 metal detector malfunction
food_safety.summary: Metal detector wouldn't pass caramel buckets at 16:16; operator power-cycled, unit operational within 2 minutes.

quality.title: ML2 packaging damage scrap
quality.summary: Broken box and bag resulted in 50 lb product scrap at 03:03.

sanitation.title: ML1 filter basket not installed at startup
sanitation.summary: 2000-micron filter basket missing from PTL/buffer tank startup; discovered during Phil's inspection at 04:59, basket installed before chocolate push — checklist exists for crisp only, not plain runs.
sanitation.status: Open — Adriana updating SOP/checklist to add filter basket step for all products.

sanitation.title: ML4 TG3 scraper missing before cleaning
sanitation.summary: TG3 scraper reported missing before 3rd shift cleaning start at 23:24; unclear if lost earlier or not installed.
sanitation.status: Open — no follow-up posted on disposition or search.

opportunities.text: Consider adding enrober wire belt inspection to S3 pre-shift checks — broken link discovered during production run at 00:42.
Consider adding 2000-micron filter basket installation to ML1 startup checklist for all products, not just crisp — based on plain chocolate startup miss at 04:59.
Review TG3 scraper accountability and pre-cleaning inspection protocol — scraper found missing before shift start with no clear loss event.
